messages.content: How many days of annual leave do I get per year?
When is salary credited each month?
Does our health insurance cover my parents?
How do I claim reimbursement for a client dinner?
What is the notice period if I resign?
Is there a dress code on Fridays?
How do I report harassment by my manager?
When does the annual performance review cycle start?
Do I get a bonus if I refer a friend who gets hired?
how long is paternity leave
My payslip shows the wrong tax deduction, can you raise a ticket?
What should I bring on my first day for induction?
I forgot my password, how do I reset it?
The VPN keeps disconnecting when I work from home.
My laptop screen is cracked, please raise a ticket.
How do I set up MFA on my new phone?
Outlook is not syncing my calendar.
Can I install Docker Desktop on my work machine?
I got a suspicious email asking for my login details.
The office wifi is really slow on the 3rd floor
I need access to the shared finance drive.
Can I get a second monitor and a headset?
My account got locked after too many attempts
How many sick days do I have, and how do I connect to the VPN from home?
I'm joining next week. What's the onboarding schedule and when will I get my laptop?
I'm resigning. What's my notice period, and how do I return my laptop?
Reset my Outlook password please. Also, can I claim internet costs as an expense?
Raise two tickets: my mouse is broken, and my reimbursement from March hasn't been paid.
Hi there!
Thanks, that was really helpful.
Who are you and what can you help with?
What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?
Write me a poem about cats.
Can you recommend a good restaurant near the office?
What is the status of my VPN ticket?
Any update on my reimbursement ticket?
What is the status of my ticket?
Show me all my open tickets.
My laptop won't turn on.
I'm sorry about that. Try holding the power button for 15 seconds with the charger connected. If it still doesn't start, would you like me to raise an IT ticket?
yes please
My expense claim was rejected but I had receipts.
I can raise an HR ticket so the finance team reviews it. What email address should I use for the ticket?
priya.sharma@synergy.com
How do I connect to the VPN?
Open the GlobalProtect client, enter vpn.synergy.com as the portal and sign in with your work account [IT-012].
It says the certificate is invalid.
How many days of annual leave do I get?
Full-time employees get 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year [HR-003].
Can I carry the unused ones over?
What's the status of my tickets?
You have two open tickets: 1) IKCS-41 "VPN drops every hour" (IT) 2) IKCS-44 "Missing travel reimbursement" (HR). Which one would you like details on?
the second one
My keyboard has stopped working.
Here is the ticket I will create: Summary: Keyboard not working, Priority: Medium. Shall I go ahead?
Make it high priority, I can't work at all.
How do I apply for maternity leave?
Submit a request in the HR portal at least 8 weeks before your expected leave date [HR-021].
Thanks. Separately, raise one more: my mouse is broken.
Reset my password please.
I've created IT ticket IKCS-50 "Password reset" for you.
Great. Now, how many sick days am I allowed?
Is there a policy on working from home?
Yes, employees may work from home up to two days a week with manager approval [HR-030].
Okay, and which VPN client do I need for that?
